# Looking for support? We want to help

Please post your question to [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/timber/timber/discussions). That’s where the contributors and other users are, and where you’re most likely to get an answer.

## Other places

You can also ask on [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/timber) using the *Timber* tag, but keep in mind that it’s not monitored as closely as Discussions.

The Timber plugin on WordPress.org is closed and its support forum is no longer monitored. Please use GitHub Discussions (for usage/support questions) or GitHub Issues (for bugs) instead.

## Supported versions

Only Timber 2.x is supported. Timber 1.x has reached its end of life and receives no updates, including security fixes. See the [Timber 2.0 Upgrade Guide](https://timber.github.io/docs/v2/upgrade-guides/2.0/).
